description: Validate the RANS, URANS or CHT input contract without compute. Verify mesh patches/material zones and units first. URANS requires an owned restart artifact. Leave turbulence_model and wall_treatment on auto unless the user asks for a model; tell the user the returned resolved_physics, with its reasons and warnings.

ConvergenceCriteria.description: Fields as in assess_convergence: window_fraction, window_iterations, max_final_residual, residuals, residual_rise_orders, min_residual_orders_dropped, forces, force_band_percent, force_band_floor, max_energy_balance_error. Unset fields keep the standard test; unknown fields are rejected.

DecisionContext.description: User intent and declared assumptions, retained with the owned job request.

FluxCoreConfig.description: As in run_simulation: physics, fluid, boundary conditions, thermal, forces and numerics. get_tool_schema has every field. Unknown fields are rejected.

MeshUnitConversion.description: Interpret existing coordinate values for this run; never rewrite the source mesh.

convergence_criteria.description: How to judge this run converged when it finishes; omit for the standard test (every residual at or below 1e-3, none rising).

gpu_count.description: GPUs for the solve (default 1). CHT and Krylov runs use one.

name: validate_simulation
title: Check simulation request
